text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
That was a lovely melody... Thank you so 
much for the wonderful present, 
Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind that blows when music stirs the 
heart... It carries a comfort distinct 
from that of running, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"You're welcome... But were you really 
okay with this? Having me play the piano 
as your birthday present, I mean."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
My skills aren't really good enough for a 
gift... Maybe I should still go get a 
proper present even now...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
No, your melodies are always like an east 
wind caressing flower buds...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Being thoroughly swept up in the wind by 
your side makes me feel as though I am in 
full bloom."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
An easterly wind... Oh, a spring breeze? 
Are you complimenting me? Thank you.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
If you put it that way, I love it too. The 
sound of Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The way you play the trumpet, Zephyr, it's 
so refreshing, so bright... let's see... 
Yeah, it's just like a morning breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"A morning breeze... What a wonderfully 
flattering comparison."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san, would you allow me to 
celebrate your birthday with the morning 
breeze of my Shinpu?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Really? Fufu, I'm really looking forward 
to it!"
